disposition_reason: Supports a non-detect result for gallium in one food, honey, at a stated quantification limit. Does not support any dietary intake estimate.
disposition_locator: Table notes, pp. 10 to 11; Table notes, p. 11

study.method: Honey samples were digested and analyzed by ICP-MS for 30 elements, with results compared across region, honey type and year.

regulatory_or_exposure: Gallium not detected in any of 61 honey samples; LoQ 0.04 µg/L in solution
